name: AuraMusic v3.2.0 - Studio Audio Fusion & Touch Gestures
body:
## AuraMusic v3.2.0 - Studio Audio Fusion & Touch Gestures

AuraMusic v3.2.0 brings an upgraded audiophile listening and fullscreen media viewing experience to Android and Desktop.

### Highlights & Key Improvements

* **Audiophile Sound Engine**:
  - Direct hardware USB DAC bypass supporting bit-perfect PCM output up to 192 kHz / 24-bit.
  - Live audio signal chain inspection dialog.
  - Studio audio master catalogue upgrade (lossless FLAC and high-bitrate 320k Opus/AAC).
  - Beat-matched Automix with custom crossfade windows (0-12s) and gapless playback.
  - 10-band graphic equalizer with preamp gain and bass boost.

* **Fullscreen Gesture Video Player**:
  - Left-side vertical swipe for smooth brightness control (0% to 100%) with vertical capsule HUD.
  - Right-side vertical swipe for volume control with tactile haptic vibration clicks.
  - Double-tap seek with accumulating ripple pulses (-5s / +5s).
  - Two-finger continuous pinch-to-zoom (up to 3.5x magnification with centroid panning).
  - Press and hold for 2.0x rapid playback boost.
  - One-tap screen fill `[ FILL ]` / `[ FIT ]` aspect ratio toggle.
  - Touch lock `[ LOCK ]` mode to prevent accidental touches.
  - Clean Back button handling exiting fullscreen cleanly.

* **Audio-Video Fusion & Smart Sync**:
  - `[ HI-RES AUDIO OVER VIDEO ]` toggle: slaving 320kbps / FLAC studio audio to video playback.
  - Pure audio-only backgrounding: automatically releases video decoder hardware when screen is turned off or app is minimized.
  - Picture-in-Picture (PiP) popup video is disabled by default on app exit for distraction-free listening.

* **Data Economy & Network Intelligence**:
  - Live cellular vs. Wi-Fi byte tracker and saved data accumulator.
  - Automatic switch from video to studio audio upon detecting cellular data with a top notification banner.
  - `[ WATCH ANYWAY ]` button capping cellular video at 480p.
  - In-app data usage breakdown dashboard.

* **Synchronized Lyrics & Instant Asian Script Romanization**:
  - Word and syllable synchronized scrolling lyrics.
  - Dynamic Romanization engine automatically transliterating Japanese (Romaji), Korean (Hangul), and Chinese (Pinyin) into Latin characters in real time.
  - Multi-provider fallback and +/-500ms time offset adjustments.

* **Living Visuals & Low-GPU 120 FPS Motion**:
  - Kinetic ambient mesh canvas shifting with album art colors.
  - Frosted glassmorphism and cubic bezier deceleration curves.
  - In-flight shadow culling eliminating dropped frames on high-refresh displays.

* **Multiplatform Desktop Experience**:
  - Windows, macOS, and Linux multi-column widescreen layout.
  - Full keyboard shortcuts (Space, J/L, Up/Down, M, F, Ctrl+F).
  - Discord Rich Presence integration displaying live track title and progress.
  - Bit-perfect WASAPI Exclusive and ASIO output on Windows.

---

### Which File Should I Download?

* **`AuraMusic-v3.2.0-arm64-v8a.apk` (Recommended)**: For almost all modern Android phones and tablets. Smaller size (~133 MB) and fastest performance.
* **`AuraMusic-v3.2.0-universal.apk`**: Universal build containing all 4 CPU architectures for Android emulators or legacy 32-bit devices (~263 MB).
* **`AuraMusic-3.2.0-windows-portable.zip`**: Standalone Windows 10/11 desktop app. Extract the archive and launch `AuraMusic.exe` (~271 MB).
